situations.headline: Barinthus Biotherapeutics voluntarily delists ADSs from Nasdaq via Form 25

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Barinthus Biotherapeutics voluntarily delists ADSs from Nasdaq via Form 25 (interest 7, risk 7)

thesis.text: Barinthus's voluntary Form 25 delisting, filed alongside a same-day 8-K with five escalated items, signals a major corporate transition (potential merger, bankruptcy, or going-private action) whose specifics are not yet disclosed in the available filings; the situation warrants close tracking of the referenced 8-K and any subsequent proxy or tender materials before forming a directional view.
